title: RoboLab: A High-Fidelity Simulation Benchmark for Analysis of Task Generalist Policies
abstract: arXiv:2604.09860v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The pursuit of general-purpose robotics has yielded impressive foundation models, yet simulation-based benchmarking remains a bottleneck due to rapid performance saturation and a lack of true generalization testing. Existing benchmarks often exhibit significant domain overlap between training and evaluation, trivializing success rates and obscuring insights into robustness. We introduce RoboLab, a simulation benchmarking framework designed to address these challenges. Concretely, our framework is designed to answer two questions: (1) to what extent can we understand the performance of a real-world policy by analyzing its behavior in simulation, and (2) which factor most strongly affect policy behavior. First, RoboLab enables human-authored and LLM-enabled generation of scenes and tasks in a robot- and policy-agnostic manner within a high-fidelity simulation environment. translated_title: RoboLab：面向任务通用策略分析的高保真仿真基准
translated_abstract: 追求通用机器人的研究已产生了令人印象深刻的基础模型，然而基于仿真的基准测试仍因性能快速饱和和缺乏真正的泛化测试而成为瓶颈。现有基准通常在训练和评估之间存在显著领域重叠，这使成功率变得琐碎化，并掩盖了对鲁棒性的洞察。我们引入了RoboLab，一个旨在解决这些挑战的仿真基准框架。具体而言，我们的框架旨在回答两个问题：（1）通过分析仿真中的行为，我们能在多大程度上理解真实世界策略的性能；（2）哪个因素对策略行为影响最大。首先，RoboLab支持在高保真仿真环境中，以机器人和策略无关的方式，进行人工编写和LLM启用的场景与任务生成。我们同时推出了配套的RoboLab-120基准，该基准包含...
tldr: RoboLab是一个高保真仿真基准框架，通过减少训练与评估的领域重叠，系统性地分析任务通用策略的泛化能力，并识别影响策略行为的关键因素。
en_tdlr: RoboLab is a high-fidelity simulation benchmarking framework that systematically analyzes the generalization of task generalist policies by reducing domain overlap between training and evaluation, and identifies key factors affecting policy behavior.
